security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://www.youtube.com; frame-src https://www.youtube.com https://api.lunorx.xyz; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: https://i.ytimg.com https://yt3.ggpht.com https://*.googleusercontent.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Music player for YouTube Music on iPhone, iPad and Android
bundle.longDescription: LunoRX is a music player for YouTube Music with synced lyrics, local-first playlists and an optional sync backend.
